_note: Headline numbers transcribed from outputs/reports/*.md (gitignored, PHI-adjacent). Committed here so figures regenerate without re-running models. Full cohort, 3-5 seeds, 95% CI bootstrapped over stays.

robustness_mean_delta._cols: model -> {split -> mean AUPRC drop when one organ is blinded}
robustness_mean_delta._note: Single self-consistent 4-model run (3 seeds, full cohort; outputs/reports/robustness_full.md). GRU-masked = monolithic GRU trained WITH organ-block dropout augmentation (mask_prob=0.5) = missingness-aware control: augmentation halves the monolith's degradation but does not close the gap to the decomposition.

robustness_per_organ_external._cols: organ -> {model -> AUPRC with that organ blinded}; baseline (none) included. Same 4-model run as robustness_mean_delta.

ablation_test_auprc._cols: model -> {full, no_measurement (drop measurement, keep timing), physiology (drop both)}

coordination._note: MAPPO vs IPPO — measured null (centralized critic adds nothing under exogenous dynamics)

federated._note: FedAvg over 8 non-IID care-unit sites (15 rounds) vs centralized. Honest cost, not free.

clinical_test._note: Clinical metrics at the val-chosen operating point (alarm budget <=8 events/patient-day; 3 seeds; internal test). Source: outputs/reports/baselines_full.md. SENTINEL(organ)=OrganEnsemble-indep.

clinical_external_cvicu_lead_h._note: Median lead time (h) on the held-out CVICU unit, same operating point.

eicu_external._note: Frozen MIMIC models scored on eICU (122,798 stays, 208 hospitals; no-skill AUPRC 0.036); no eICU gradient updates. AUROC is the prevalence-independent cross-db metric. Rows are 5-seed (outputs/reports/eicu_external.md) EXCEPT 'SENTINEL (organ)', whose eICU figures are the 3-seed robustness full-input run (outputs/reports/eicu_robustness.md; dagger in paper) and whose int_auroc is the 3-seed baselines OrganEnsemble.

federated_eicu._note: FedAvg over genuine eICU hospital IDs (15 rounds) vs centralized; 78 federation hospitals + 15 held-out unseen; 38 zero-positive hospitals excluded. Source: outputs/reports/eicu_federated.md.
